# Daily Digest Bot

Sends daily summaries of your notes and memories to keep you informed.

## Features
- Reads your memory files and agent notes
- Compiles them into a digest
- Sends via Telegram/Discord/Email

## Usage
Just say "Send my daily digest" and I'll:
1. Read memory/*.md files
2. Compile highlights
3. Send to your configured channel

## Configuration
Set your preferred channel in TOOLS.md:
```
digest_channel: telegram
digest_recipient: @yourusername
```

Perfect for staying updated on what your agent has learned!
